Iran International (English) — confirmed published 1 October 2026, 13:05 BST. Headline: "Trump says renewed bombing of Iran after midterms 'possible'"

Asked directly whether Washington could ramp up bombing after the US midterm elections, President Donald Trump responded: "Possible."

Trump made the statement in an interview with TIME magazine. He declined to specify potential targets but said the US had spent six months replenishing weapons stockpiles:
QUOTE (Donald Trump, President of the United States): "We're stocking up at levels we've never done before."

The article records no official Iranian government response to Trump's remarks. It cites Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad-Bagher Ghalibaf's standing warning that Iran would retaliate against further military action:
QUOTE (Mohammad-Bagher Ghalibaf, Speaker of the Iranian Parliament): "In a region where we do not sell oil, no one will sell oil, and if our security is not ensured, no infrastructure will be safe."

Iran rejected Trump's characterisation of its ceasefire proposal, with officials indicating they awaited an official US response through Qatari mediators.
